summary: Completed comprehensive testing of KYC Admin system enhancements. All 10 backend API endpoints working correctly (100% pass rate). Frontend features fully functional including tabs with counters, search, lightbox with zoom/rotate, rejection modal with 6 reasons + validation, audit history with Spanish relative dates, and CRITICAL BUG FIX verified: selfie images display correctly (not empty 'data:,').

minor_issues.workaround: ESC key works, clicking outside modal works, Cancel button works
minor_issues.note: Not a functional blocker - multiple alternative ways to close modal work correctly
